What We Do

Our Roofing Services

From clearing a blocked gutter to stripping and re-tiling a whole roof, every job is done by our own team.

New Roofs

Stripped, felted, battened and re-tiled, with a typical roof done in four to five days.

Roof Repairs

Slipped and broken tiles or slates replaced and leaks traced back to their cause.

Flat Roofing

Old felt stripped back and the roof covered in a seamless rubber membrane.

Why Choose Sandon Roofing

We are a team of nine and we have been in business for 15 years. When a roof is urgent we can strip, felt, batten and re-tile it in two days.

  • 15 Years in Business

    Fifteen years of roofing work behind every quote we give.

  • Quick When It Matters

    An emergency re-roof can be stripped and re-tiled in two days, and a typical job takes four to five.

  • 10 Year Guarantee

    Our work comes with a 10 year guarantee. Ask us what it covers on your job.

  • Trained Team of Nine

    City and Guilds, health and safety, first aid, manual handling and construction qualifications.

  • Local to Stafford

    Working across Stafford, Lichfield, Tamworth, Cannock and Stoke-on-Trent.

The Team Behind Sandon Roofing
